clusters.state_of_play: The Iran war's fallout continues as Trump is reported (per Axios scoop) to plan meeting Gulf leaders at the UN General Assembly next Tuesday to discuss the war's next steps, amid reports that ceasefire talks have stalled while Gulf states face escalating Iran and Houthi attacks. Separately, Trump publicly claimed the US is nearing the end of the conflict and asserted direct talks with Tehran are underway. This follows the House's third vote (220-204) to limit Trump's Iran war powers, a CBO report putting war costs at $38 billion through August 1 with $2-3 billion/month ongoing and up to five years to rebuild munitions stockpiles, and continued fallout from the Saudi pipeline shutdown and Houthi seizure of Yemen's Red Sea coastline.
